description: This file defines the 'Permission' class within the Opencart admin startup controllers, responsible for checking user permissions based on the current route and redirecting to an error page if permission is denied.

classes.name: Permission
classes.description: Handles permission checking for different routes in the admin startup process.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Checks if the current route has the necessary permissions; if not, returns an action to redirect to the 'error/permission' page.
